desc:
📞 2:40 AM… Your grandma is calling: "Sara never came back from the school trip."

A Saudi story horror game with full voice acting 🇸🇦
🔦 Search for Sara in the neighborhood, the abandoned school and the desert
🧩 Solve puzzles with your friends (1–4 players)
👁️ Be careful… something tall dressed in black is watching you in the dark… and counting
📱 Your phone camera sees what your eyes can't

Will you find Sara? And what secret is waiting for you at the end?

🌍 Available in 18 languages
